analyzed_vuln.description: The root cause is an unconditional debug log call in `Crypto::ASN1::parse_utc_time` when a UTCTime contains a timezone offset (`+/-hhmm`). The call `dbgln("FIXME: Implement UTCTime with offset!")` has zero format arguments, which instantiates `VariadicFormatParams<>` with an empty `AK::Array<...,0>` and triggers UBSan in `set_parameters(m_data)` (AK/Format.h:298) due to zero-sized array/span handling. So the bug is in parse_utc_time’s logging path, not certificate parsing itself.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: FuzzASN1 passes attacker-controlled DER bytes into `TLS::Certificate::parse_asn1`, which parses certificate validity times and forwards UTCTime strings to `parse_utc_time`. To trigger this PoV, input must make the time parser accept a UTCTime with an explicit offset (`+` or `-` branch), causing execution of the `dbgln` line. Under sanitizer build, that zero-argument dbgln path causes UB in formatting machinery and crashes.
